annotations.title: Get a nursing home inspection and the inspector's statements

description: The tool gets one nursing home inspection by the home's six-character CCN and, optionally, the inspection date (YYYY-MM-DD). It gets the latest inspection when you omit the date. It returns each health citation with its tag, scope and severity, and the inspector's statement from Form CMS-2567 exactly as CMS publishes it. CMS removes or brackets terms that could identify a resident. OpenHealth adds nothing and summarizes nothing. The result shortens long statements, and the page shows them in full.

ccn.description: The nursing home's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN), such as 015009.

date.description: Enter the inspection date as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out to get the latest inspection.
